attempts.summary: On node1, built a persistent LVM-backed filesystem for /srv/data (loop-attached backing file → LVM PV/VG/LV → XFS, mounted via fstab, loop attachment made boot-persistent via a systemd unit ordered before LVM activation). Populated /srv/data with application data, took an LVM COW snapshot (data_snap), then modified the live directory (deleted files, tampered config, added a rogue file). Restored the directory to the exact pre-modification state via `lvconvert --merge` and verified byte-for-byte via sha256 manifest diff (zero differences). Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured boot_id + health baseline, rebooted via `systemctl reboot`, confirmed boot_id changed, and confirmed the loop device, LVM VG/LV, mount, and data content all recovered automatically and matched the baseline exactly.
